rationale: Lycopolitan verbal noun of molding/fashioning, parallel to but distinct from ⲡⲗⲁⲥⲙⲁ. Possibly cognate with Sahidic ϣⲱⲡⲧ̄ 'knead' or with ⲱⲡⲧ̄ 'be united, joined.' Central technical term of this chapter (kephalaion 53 'Concerning the Molding of Man'), occurring 7+ times: ⲡⲱⲁⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ = 'the Molding of Man' as the cosmic fashioning-form of the human person, sent into the war against Matter.

Verb of pursuit/running with directional ⲁ-, used three times on this page (lines 11, 14, 24) of cosmic agents running toward their objects: the Molding runs at Matter, the archons run after the Molding, the Molding runs at the counsels of Death. Possibly Lycopolitan reflex of ⲡⲱⲧ 'run' with reduplication, or a distinct verb.

Nominalized form of ⲧⲱⲣⲡ̄ 'snatch, seize, plunder' (Sahidic). The construction ⲡⲡⲧⲱⲣⲡⲝ̄ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄ⲍⲁⲏ 'the snatching in your end' refers to a final eschatological seizure that the addressees will not undergo.

proposed_english: to be made empty / to be emptied out
rationale: Verbalized form ⲣ̄- + ⲭⲁⲓⲉ (likely Lyc. for ϫⲁⲉⲓⲉ 'desert, be empty/desolate') + ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth.' Used here of the cosmic storehouses of the elements being emptied out of their contents into the formed cosmos.
Greek loanword λίμνη 'lake.' Used in the simile of lines 20-23 comparing Death's storehouse to a lake whose creatures are hunted while the depths and plants are left behind.
Coptic verb 'grow, sprout' (cf. Sah. ⲣⲱⲧ). Used qualitatively here of plants that grow in the lake. Distinct from ⲣⲍⲱⲧ ⲛⲍⲏⲧϩ 'be rooted in' already in vocabulary.
Lycopolitan reflex of Sahidic ⲧⲱϭⲉ 'plant, planting.' Plural ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲇⲉ 'the plants' that grow in the lake.
Variant of ⲍⲁⲗⲏⲧ already in accumulated vocabulary; here in possessed plural form ⲛⲉⲥⲍⲁⲗⲉⲧⲉ 'her birds.'
Standard Coptic qualitative ⲧⲛ̄ⲧⲱⲛ 'be like, be likened.' Used here in correspondence-marker ⲧⲛⲧⲁⲛⲧ ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲣⲏⲧⲉ ⲙⲛ̄ 'is likened in this manner with...' Cf. accumulated ⲥⲧⲛⲧⲁⲛⲧ 'that which is likened.'
